Operation “Tigers” 🫡🇺🇦
Soldiers from the 11th Brigade of the National Guard, with the help of local residents, rescued six cats from the occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region.
The animals were placed in a cage specially made for the operation and transported by air across the Dnipro River under the wing of a heavy bomber drone. The soldiers covered a distance of more than ten kilometers.
All six are alive and unharmed. 🙏
